subject: Slot coverage request: candidate Ravi Shah — mixed-UTC panel and debrief plan
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Slot coverage request: Ravi Shah — quick orchestration

Hi team,

We have a final-round candidate, Ravi Shah (resume attached), who is available for interviews on Thu 3/23 between 09:00-15:00 UTC. His schedule is tight and he can only do two back-to-back panels: a 60-min System Design (technical) followed immediately by a 30-min Behavioral/debrief window.

Current asks:
- We need one senior IC for System Design (60m) + one interviewer for Behavioral (30m).
- Someone to own the panel debrief facilitation + score capture (I can share the debrief template).
- If you take a slot, please confirm now so I can lock calendar invites and update the candidate.

Constraints:
- Marissa, I know you prefer mornings UTC; Karthik, you flagged limited availability after 13:00 UTC.
- Candidate is on a tight timeline; hiring manager (Susan Reid at Acme) is asking for end-of-week feedback.

Attachments: ravi_shah-pack.pdf (resume + take-home summary). I also attached a provisional calendar invite with UTC variants.

Plan idea: assign SD to the most experienced interviewer, Behavioral to a second pair, and Jonas to run the 10-min structured debrief immediately after the panel to keep feedback fresh.

Can you reply with: which slot you can cover (09:00 / 11:00 / 13:00 UTC), and who will own the debrief?

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Recruiting Operations Lead | Redwood Inference

To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

I can take the 11:00 UTC System Design slot (60m). I have a recurring sync at 13:30 UTC, so 13:00 is tight for me.

I can also do the debrief if Jonas is overloaded, but I prefer to focus on SD and let Jonas run the debrief as you suggested.

Marissa

Monica / Marissa,

Thanks for coordinating. Ravi confirms 11:00 UTC works best for him, and he can do 09:00 if needed. He prefers to avoid anything after 14:00 UTC. Susan (hiring manager) is hoping to get feedback by EOD Friday — happy to be on standby for a short sync if helpful.

Please include the take-home summary from his packet when sharing notes.

Best,
